{{Quote|This is a case in which we were able to exploit the Empire's nonacceptance of alien species. In treating aliens as lesser beings, many Imperials became incapable in seeing unusual alien life-forms as intelligent. Indeed, vuv Tertarrnek's work would be much more difficult&mdash;perhaps impossible&mdash;with more enlightened foes.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], on the Covallon spy Dælar vuv Tertarrnek|<ref name="CRO" />}}
The '''Covallon''' were a bestial [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] rarely seen away from their [[Covallon homeworld|homeworld]]. The descendants of swift predatory quadrupeds, the Covallon had a developed capacity for sensing others' emotions, a holdover from [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] in packs. Covallon society developed to an early information technology level by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], although most Covallon were comfortable with more advanced technology. The Covallon [[Dælar vuv Tertarrnek]] served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]], having been given to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harlov Jarnek]] as a pet. From that position vuv Tertarrnek fed the Alliance with strategic information on Imperial [[Imperial Army/Legends|troop]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]] movements in the [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Covallon were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They were quadrupeds, having evolved from a swift plains-based predator species. They preferred to walk on all four [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], although they were physically capable of walking upright when the need arose. On all fours, they averaged a height of 0.9&ndash;1.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] at the shoulder; while standing on their hind legs, they averaged between 1.8&ndash;2.2 meters. Their lower limbs ended in three-toed feet, while their upper limbs ended in four-fingered hands; the digits on both hands and feet were tipped with a sharp claw. Their hands were dexterous and capable of fine manipulation. The Covallon also had a long tail.<ref name="CRO" />

The Covallon were largely bald, with a pattern of darker markings across their skin. However, a thick mane of hair grew around their shoulders and upper arms. The Covallon head was bald and had a central, backward-pointing horn. They had two small [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and a blunt muzzle with a jaw filled with sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], a reflection of their carnivorous nature. A number of thin tendrils grew out of each side of their jaws. Overall, the Covallon had a bestial appearance&mdash;at least to [[Human/Legends|Human]] eyes.<ref name="CRO" />

==Society and culture==
Despite being an ancient species, Covallon society remained at an early information technology level; however, Covallon were also comfortable with more advanced [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] machines and technology. They took a long view of events, preferring to wait out adversity rather than take premature action. They invested a significant amount of time planning things before taking action. The Covallon ancestors [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] in packs. In modern Covallon, that manifested in a strong empathetic ability, enabling them to sense the emotions of others. As a consequence, Covallon worked very well in teams, functioning like a finely-crafted machine.<ref name="CRO" />

Covallon did not feel the need to wear clothing; however, they generally wore clothing of some sort out of protection or for practical purposes. It was common for clothed and unclothed Covallon to mingle freely.<ref name="CRO" /> The Covallon could understand [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|315|Dælar vuv Tertarrnek}}</ref> Covallon naming conventions included the use of "æ"<ref name="CRO" /> (the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Enth/Legends|Enth]])<ref name="Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised]]''</ref> as well as two-part surnames in which the first particle was de-capitalized.<ref name="CRO" />

==History==
The Covallon were an ancient species that evolved from a quadruped predator. They developed a low-level information technology society at which point development largely plateaued. They were rarely seen away from their [[Covallon homeworld|homeworld]], and as a consequence, few beings were familiar with their species. Those Covallon who did venture forth from their homeworld often encountered condescension from more [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species, who viewed them more as creatures than intelligent beings.<ref name="CRO" />

==Covallon in the galaxy==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Covallon [[Dælar vuv Tertarrnek]] served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. The Alliance arranged for vuv Tertarrnek to be given to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harlov Jarnek]], ruler of [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]], as a pet. Jarnek was unaware vuv Tertarrnek's intelligence and, due to the [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] attitudes common in the Empire, failed to even consider that he might be sentient. 

Jarnek became very fond of his "pet" and allowed Vuv Tertarrnek to accompany him almost everywhere, including high-security conferences. From that position, vuv Terkarrnek obtained confidential information relating to Imperial [[Imperial Army/Legends|troop]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]] movements within and through the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], as well as top-priority codes. Vuv Tertarrnek then relayed that information to the Alliance in coded bursts from a long-range, tight-beam communication hidden within [[Moff Jarnek's palace]] on [[Spirador]].<ref name="CRO" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Rebel Alliance was preparing a plan to arrest Jarken on Spirador, considering him a threat based on the large number of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] under his control.<ref name="ANH">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Covallon were created by [[Stephen Crane]] for the [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', published in [[1994]]. It contained one illustration of a Covallon, drawn by [[Mike Vilardi]].<ref name="CRO" />
